LocalPilot Core — persistent tasks, explicit permissions, independent service

positional arguments:
  {init,start,stop,restart,status,doctor,models,tasks,logs,config,_serve,service-unregister,ask,agent,chat,task}
    init                Configure existing model without loading/downloading
                        it
    ask                 Reasoning only
    agent               Submit standard Agent task through Permission Gateway
    chat                Reasoning only

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --home HOME
  --json                JSON; streaming commands emit newline-delimited event
                        objects followed by final task

usage: localpilot-service [-h] --config CONFIG [--check]

python -m localpilot_service --config /private/service.json

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --check          Validate configuration and checkpoints without inference

usage: localpilot-channels [-h] --config CONFIG --state-dir STATE_DIR
                           [--port PORT]
                           [--task-timeout-seconds TASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS]

Loopback QQ/WeChat facade for official LocalPilot Agent service

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       JSON with environment variable NAMES, never credential
                        values
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
                        New private directory outside all repositories and
                        task workspaces
  --port PORT
  --task-timeout-seconds TASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        Task deadline including manual approvals (maximum
                        3600)
